Reception tours will resume on Wednesday 23rd September, and will be weekly until Wednesday 13th January, 2027 (two days before the Reception Application deadline). Please complete this form in order to book a tour of our school.
Tours start at 09:30 and last around an hour. We will be accompanied by some Yr6 pupils who'll be only too pleased to answer your questions.
If you are having any difficulties accessing the form, please contact the school office on 0208 692 2762.
